description: Generate a changeset and changelog entry from a PR's commits, grouped by conventional-commit type in the repo's own convention, with a semver bump suggestion.

commits.description: Commits in the PR (at least one)

hash.description: Commit hash (optional; carried for reference, not printed)

type.description: Conventional-commit type, e.g. feat or fix (optional; missing groups under other)

group_order.description: Group types in the order they should appear (optional)

include_files.description: Whether to include the Files changed section (optional, default true)

package_name.description: Package name appended to the heading (optional)

name: generate_changeset
